light_description: Hungarian handmade octave fuzz based on the Ampeg Scrambler, with blend/texture control and optional boost for guitar and bass.
Vintage-radio styled enclosure housing a selectable vintage gain circuit, including Rangemaster, Fuzz Face, Vox Tone Bender V828, and Tone Bender MKII options.
Vintage-radio styled gain pedal from the Hungarian vintage-radio series with selectable classic fuzz/boost circuits.
Young Artist series germanium Tone Bender MKII fuzz with internal bias and individually created artwork.
Germanium Tone Bender MK1.5 fuzz with bias control and modern or original-spec construction options.
Silicon Fuzz Face-style fuzz with bias control and BC108B transistors.
Germanium Tone Bender MKII-style fuzz with bias control and selectable transistor sets.
Germanium Vox Tone Bender V828-style fuzz with bias control and selectable transistor/construction options.
Germanium Tone Bender MKIII-style fuzz using Tungsram/Tesla germanium transistors.
Germanium Fuzz Face-style fuzz with bias control and selectable NOS germanium transistors.

Vintage Videoton picnic-radio styled enclosure with selectable classic gain circuits.

Vintage Videoton-radio styled enclosure with selectable Rangemaster, Fuzz Face, Vox Tone Bender V828, Tone Bender MKII, or Tone Bender MKI circuits.
